greet.text: Ah, you must be my new tenant! Welcome to Ban Suan, dear.

offer.text: A home is more than four walls. Why don't you go and meet the neighbours?

accept.text: Start with my nephew Ken at the corner shop, then see the clock tower. Come back and tell me what you think!

decline.text: Suit yourself. I'll be right here when you're ready.

a.text: Still exploring? Ken's shop is east of the market, past the avenue.
Back already! So, what do you think of our little town?

love.text: Ha! I knew you would. You're one of us now.

quiet.text: Quiet? Just wait. Things here have a way of changing.

a.text: Everyone's been talking about you, you know. Good things, mostly.
